record_scope_reconstruction: Two distinct provincial observations: eight unnamed Attapeu local posts towards Vietnam and Cambodia, and four unnamed Sekong posts towards Vietnam. Phoukeua international crossing is reported open in this provincial account.

source_checks.finding: RFA explicitly separates the eight Attapeu and four Sekong closures, without naming facilities.
VNA describes a separate national gate measure; its named list is not evidence identifying the smaller provincial posts.

onset: RFA's March 16 provincial accounts support eight smaller Attapeu posts and four Sekong posts closed, with Phoukeua open. Two distinct provincial observations are appropriate; exact onset, gate identities and repeal are unknown.

By 2022-09-01, Laos had authorized provinces to reopen local and traditional border checkpoints under controls. This is later national permission, not proof of the reopening date or actual operation of all eight unnamed Attapeu and four unnamed Sekong posts. No continuous closure through 2022 or beyond is established.

unresolved: The affected local-post roster and coordinates are unverified. Neither the entire national frontier nor the international gate can replace the unnamed subsets.
